# Angel Stones Interface Guidelines

**Design with a shared language. Build for the work people need to do.**

ASIG is an open-source foundation of semantic design tokens, framework-neutral CSS,
accessible interaction contracts and complete page guidance. It supports Operations,
CAD and Marketing products while keeping each application's business behavior in its
own codebase.

[Explore the live catalogue](https://prabhuvajjiram.github.io/agis/) · [View the source](https://github.com/prabhuvajjiram/agis) · [Release history](https://github.com/prabhuvajjiram/agis/releases)

## Explore before integrating

Use the [foundations gallery](https://prabhuvajjiram.github.io/agis/site/foundations.html) to compare themes and copy
token values. The [page guide](https://prabhuvajjiram.github.io/agis/site/pages.html) demonstrates Orders, Workbench
and order detail with loading, empty, error and restricted states. Examples use invented
data; they do not connect to an ERP or save business records.

The wiki provides orientation. Versioned guidance in [docs/](https://github.com/prabhuvajjiram/agis/tree/main/docs)
and the package version pinned by your application are the implementation reference.
